notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Scans for rservices ports: rsh (514), rlogin (513), rexec (512). R-services are legacy remote access protocols replaced by SSH precisely because of their trust-based authentication model. Any exposure is an immediate finding.

=== TRUST FILE ABUSE ===
/etc/hosts.equiv: globally trusts specific hosts/users. .rhosts in home directory: per-user trust. '+ +' in .rhosts: any user from any host, no credential check.

=== CHAINING ===
Discover rservices → attempt rlogin from attacker IP → if trusted (source IP in .rhosts or hosts.equiv): unauthenticated shell → rwho/rusers to identify other active sessions for lateral movement.
